sensitiveAccessUnavailable: File, command and transfer access is unavailable while impersonating an owner.
title: Activity
description: Commands, file transfers and lifecycle actions run in your sandboxes. Rows show status only; open one to see its output.

empty.title: No operations yet
empty.description: Operations are recorded when a sandbox is created, runs a command, transfers a file or changes state.
empty.filteredDescription: Nothing matches these filters. Change or clear them to see more.

rowCap_one: Showing the newest {{count}} operation. Filter by sandbox, status or type to find older ones.
rowCap_other: Showing the newest {{count}} operations. Filter by sandbox, status or type to find older ones.

stateHint.pending: Waiting for the host. The status changes only when the host reports it.
stateHint.unknown: The server cannot tell whether the host did this. The daemon retries stop and destroy automatically; other operations are not retried. Check the sandbox before acting again.
stateHint.commandUnknown: The outcome is unknown. Guest work may remain alive. No command retry is available; stop or destroy the sandbox to recover.
stateHint.waitingForCapacity: Waiting for capacity: the pool is full and this create is in line. It holds no host resources yet.
stateHint.waitingForRestoreHost: Restore queued: waiting for a host this sandbox may use to have room. Its disk stays in the image store until then.

error.credential_inactive: The authorizing credential is no longer valid
error.egress_resolution_failed: An egress domain could not be resolved to an allowed IPv4 destination
error.egress_guard_unavailable: This host's network guard is not running; the sandbox did not start. Try again later or use another host
error.open_egress_not_permitted: This host's owner does not allow open internet for other users' sandboxes; the sandbox did not start. Create a new sandbox
error.host_disconnect_expired: The host stayed disconnected too long and stopped it
error.host_runtime_unsupported: The host runtime does not support it
error.idempotency_conflict: Idempotency key reused with a different request
error.lease_exceeds_policy: The requested lifetime exceeds the allowed maximum
error.vm_size_mismatch: VM size conflicts with the accepted allocation
error.start_disk_missing: This sandbox can't start: its host has no usable disk for it. Create a new sandbox.
error.superseded: Superseded by a newer sandbox action
error.sandbox.template_image_missing: The exact template image is missing on the host. Restore it and verify the revision again.
error.fs_not_directory: Guest path is not a directory.
error.fs_not_regular: Guest path is not a regular file.
error.fs_cross_device: Guest paths are on different devices.
error.fs_entry_too_large: Guest entry exceeds the result limit.
error.fs_listing_limit: Guest listing exceeds the observation limit.
error.signal_unsupported_on_guest: Guest does not support safe process group signals.
error.provision_timeout: Did not become ready in time
error.startup_failed: Start command could not be launched
error.guest_network_unavailable: The sandbox got no network address
error.credential_install_failed: A login could not be installed
error.credential_spec_invalid: Login specification could not be verified
error.credential_capture_failed: A login could not be saved before stopping
error.disk_stale: The cached disk was out of date; start again to restore the stored copy
error.connection_refused: Nothing in the sandbox accepted the connection
error.restore_boot_failed: The restored disk did not boot; its stored copy is kept
error.restore_cleanup_pending: Cleanup of a failed restore is pending; retry the cleanup or destroy the sandbox (destroy deletes the stored copy)
error.placement_infeasible: Can no longer be placed in this pool
error.guest_sudo_not_permitted: This host's owner does not allow root (sudo) in other users' sandboxes; the sandbox did not start. Create a new sandbox
error.guest_sudo_unavailable: Root (sudo) was requested, but the grant failed: the image has no usable sudo, or it refused the rule; the sandbox did not start
error.guest_root_granted: The image already gives the guest user root (a sudoers rule, membership of the group named sudo, docker or doas) although root was not requested; the sandbox did not start
error.root_disk_not_grown: The image's root filesystem could not grow to this sandbox's disk (it lacks growpart or a resize tool, or its root layout is unsupported); the sandbox did not start. Create it at the template's minimum disk, or fix the image
error.restore_no_allowed_host: No allowed host had room for the restore
error.credential.not_attached: A login this restore names is no longer attached to the sandbox
error.credential.not_found: A login attached to this sandbox no longer exists
error.credential.account_not_found: A login account this restore needs no longer exists
error.credential.instance_not_found: A login instance this restore needs no longer exists
error.credential.definition_corrupt: A login's stored definition is corrupt; the restore cannot install it
error.credential.spec_too_large: The sandbox's login specification is too large to restore
error.credential.env_conflict: Two attached logins set the same environment variable
error.credential.in_use: The restore's wait ended while every matching login instance was in use
error.credential.busy: The restore's wait ended while a login it needs was held by a running sandbox or a login session
error.credential.pending_drain: The restore's wait ended while a login it needs was still being released elsewhere
error.credential.needs_login: The restore's wait ended while no matching login instance was ready; log in or upload a value, then start again
error.credential.account_paused: The restore's wait ended while a login account it needs was paused
error.credential.limit_reached: The restore's wait ended while a login limit was reached
error.credential.host_forbidden: The restore's wait ended while an attached login was not allowed on any host with room
error.credential.recovery_required: The restore's wait ended while a login it needs required recovery
error.credential.path_conflict: Two attached logins' files overlap; detach one, then start again
error.credential.unavailable: CLI logins are not available on this server; the restore cannot install its logins

detail.notFoundDescription: It does not exist, or it is not yours.
detail.sandboxDeleted: This sandbox has been deleted. The status and output below are what was recorded; nothing arriving later changes that.
detail.hostOffline: Host {{host}} is not connected ({{state}}). The status may be out of date until it reconnects.
detail.commandNotStored: Command text is not stored. Only the status, exit code and output are kept.

cancel.title: Cancel this operation?
cancel.description: The host stops the work (for a command, its whole process group). Until the host confirms, the operation shows Cancelling; if it finishes first, its own result stands.
cancel.waiting: Cancellation requested. Waiting for the host to confirm the work stopped.
cancel.waitingOffline: Cancellation requested. The host is not connected, so it is delivered when the host reconnects.

answer.cancelled: Cancelled. The host confirmed nothing more runs.
answer.cancelledQueued: Cancelled before it reached a host. It never ran.
answer.finishedFirst: It finished before the cancellation arrived, so its result stands.
answer.unknown: The outcome is unknown: the server cannot tell whether the host stopped it.

problem.notFound: This operation no longer exists, or it is not yours.
problem.notCancellable: This operation can no longer be cancelled. Its sandbox may have changed; the page shows the latest status.
problem.forbidden: You are not allowed to cancel this operation.
problem.generic: The cancellation could not be sent. Try again.

output.signedOut: Your session has ended. Sign in again to read command output.
output.title: Output
output.live: Live: new output appears while the command runs.
output.waitingFinal: The command has finished. Reading its last output…
output.unsealed: The host never confirmed the end of this output, so it may be incomplete.
output.expired: This output was deleted 24 hours after the command finished. Its status and exit code are still shown.
output.notFound: This output is no longer available.
output.truncated: Only part of the output is kept: the first {{head}} and the last {{tail}}. Marked ranges were not kept.
output.restarted: The host ran this command again, so its output started over.
output.stalled: The server is not answering. Retrying; the output shown so far stays.
output.offline: Couldn't reach the server. Retrying; the output shown so far stays.
output.stderrLegend: Standard error is shown in red.
